NameWithoutSubText: The Eastern Pickle Company Alu Bukhara Achar
LongDescription: The Eastern Pickle Company Alu Bukhara Achar 215g is a tangy and flavorful plum pickle made using premium-quality Alu Bukhara (dried plums) and a blend of aromatic spices. This traditional achar (pickle) is perfect for enhancing the flavor of your meals, offering a delightful combination of sweetness and spiciness.rnrnIngredients: Alu Bukhara (Dried Plums), Mustard Oil, Spices (Turmeric, Red Chili Powder, Fenugreek Seeds, etc.), Salt, Sugar, Acidic Regulator (Acetic Acid).rnrnUses: As a Side Dish: Pairs perfectly with rice, parathas, or chapatis.rnFlavor Enhancer: Adds a tangy and sweet twist to meals.rnSnack Companion: Enjoy with crackers or bread for a quick treat.
